summary: Render/camera object initializer (a1) with parameter dispatch. Clears flag at this+0x4, dispatches through the object's vtable when a2 != 61 (opcode 10, expected 61) and when a3 != 424 (opcode 19, expected 424), then zeroes the 0x1A8-byte struct while preserving and restoring the vtable pointer, sets ready byte at this+0xC to 1, calls RenderVTableObjectInit, zeroes trailing fields, calls sub_5115EE, calls DirectorCameraObjectSetup, conditionally updates global byte_5D79DC via EFLAGSRegisterCheck when it equals 2, sets count field this+0x10 to 200 and returns the last call result.

Set byte_5D79DC to the result of EFLAGSRegisterCheck()

Return the DirectorCameraObjectSetup result (or EFLAGS result when refresh path ran)
